categories.name: Main Dishes
categories.description: Hearty, soul-warming dishes from Burkina Faso

dishes.name: Riz Gras
dishes.description: A celebratory one-pot dish of fragrant rice simmered with tomatoes, vegetables, and your choice of tender lamb or chicken. A West African comfort classic that brings families together.

dishes.name: Poulet Bicyclette
dishes.description: Free-range chicken marinated in ginger, garlic, and aromatic spices, grilled to perfection. Named after the chickens that roam freely, this dish captures the authentic flavors of village life.

dishes.name: Tiga Dega Na
dishes.description: Slow-cooked peanut butter stew with tender beef, okra, and aromatic vegetables. A rich, nutty masterpiece served over steamed rice or with traditional tô.

dishes.name: Poisson Braisé
dishes.description: Whole tilapia grilled over open flame with a spicy marinade of chili, onions, and tomatoes. Served with attiéké (cassava couscous) for a coastal West African experience.

categories.name: Sides & Staples
categories.description: Traditional accompaniments to complete your meal

dishes.name: Tô
dishes.description: Smooth, hearty dough made from millet or sorghum flour. The soul of Burkinabè cuisine, perfect for scooping up rich sauces and stews.

dishes.name: Attiéké
dishes.description: Fermented cassava couscous with a slightly tangy flavor and fluffy texture. A beloved side across West Africa.

dishes.name: Aloco
dishes.description: Sweet fried plantains caramelized to golden perfection, served with a spicy tomato and onion sauce.

dishes.name: Sauce Gombo
dishes.description: Velvety okra sauce simmered with tomatoes, palm oil, and traditional spices. A nutritious complement to any main dish.

categories.name: Traditional Drinks
categories.description: Refreshing beverages inspired by West African traditions

dishes.name: Bissap
dishes.description: Vibrant hibiscus tea served chilled with a hint of mint and ginger. Ruby-red refreshment that's both tart and sweet.

dishes.name: Gnamakoudji
dishes.description: Refreshing ginger juice with a citrus twist. Spicy, invigorating, and perfect for warm Australian days.

dishes.name: Tamarind Juice
dishes.description: Sweet and tangy juice made from tamarind pulp, a tropical delight with a unique flavor profile.

categories.name: Sweet Endings
categories.description: Traditional West African desserts and treats

dishes.name: Dêguê
dishes.description: Creamy millet yogurt pudding with a hint of vanilla, topped with fresh pineapple and coconut. Light, refreshing, and authentically West African.

dishes.name: Beignets
dishes.description: Golden fried dough fritters dusted with sugar. Crispy outside, fluffy inside—perfect with coffee or tea.

cateringPackages.name: Celebration Spread
cateringPackages.description: Ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, and small celebrations (20-40 guests)
includes: Dessert table with Dêguê and Beignets

cateringPackages.name: Grand Event
cateringPackages.description: For weddings, corporate events, and large gatherings (50+ guests)
